title: Very Pretty, Runs Small
text:
Very Pretty, Runs Small. I am pleased with my new Oirpro Yellow Pillow Covers 18x18 inch with Pom-poms. There was one issue that is very important to note. These are not 18" square, but actually 16" square. I had to double check with a tape measure, and they are certainly not 18" square. I was slightly disappointed, and would be more so if I didn't have 16" pillow inserts. I would only recommend the 18" size for the 16" inserts. 18" pillows may cause the zipper to become stuck easily as the covers would be over-stuffed.

Aside from the small size, these are really pretty. I like the soft texture and the way the zippers are hidden, which are smooth. The construction, besides the too-small size, is solid and the color is exactly what I expected. I ordered the yellow version, which looks really nice in our 70s inspired bedroom. I find them to be a fair value if they were listed for smaller pillow inserts. I hope you have found my experience useful to you and kindly will click the button below.
